sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Patient 
WHERE strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Birthday) < 70 
AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID 
    FROM Laboratory 
    WHERE CRE >= 1.5
)
